i1.title: Ajmal My Stellar Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A bright citrus-floral that dries down soft and sweet.

Ajmal My Stellar Eau de Parfum 100ml opens with sparkling bergamot, lemon and pink grapefruit, moves into a floral heart of magnolia, jasmine and peach blossom, and settles on a smooth base of vanilla, orchid, amber and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Pink Grapefruit
  • Heart: Magnolia, Jasmine, Peach Blossom
  • Base: Vanilla, Orchid, Amber, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Ajmal
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Fruity · Musky
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A sparkling citrus opening of bergamot and pink grapefruit
  • A soft floral heart of magnolia and jasmine
  • A warm, sweet base of vanilla, amber and musk
  • Eau de Parfum strength from Ajmal

FAQ

What does My Stellar smell like?

Bergamot, lemon and pink grapefruit first, then magnolia, jasmine and peach blossom, finishing with vanilla, orchid, amber and musk.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
